input_contract.scaling: causal rolling z-score over rows [i-256, i)

design.deviation: E2 run by lead decision after E1 gate failure; not a gate pass

early_stopping.score: mean(net daily Sharpe TRAIN, INNER_A), frozen deterministic checkpoint

design.episode: one random TRAIN calendar segment (week); capital 10,000 USD per episode
design.reward: 100 x delta mark-to-market equity / 10,000, net of all costs, UNSHAPED
design.action: x[0] target position (dead band 1/3), x[1] TP sigma in [0.25,3], x[2] SL sigma in [0.5,3]
